textures: Grain/noise overlay on the entire page body (using fixed mix-blend-overlay with an SVG noise pattern or CSS).
Subtle glowing radial gradients behind major sections.

instructions: Hero Kinetic Typography: Use Framer Motion for line-by-line masked reveal. Text should rise up from a hidden overflow container.
Hover states on domain cards: Gentle -translate-y-1, glow effect on the border.
Marquee: Very slow editorial drift using react-fast-marquee. Text: 'PRESENTED BY AIWEBTOOLS.AI • PREMIUM WEB3 DOMAINS •' etc.
Staggered entrance animations for domain cards within a category.

layouts.grid_system: The Bento/Tetris Grid Protocol. Wide gap-8 to gap-12. Generous padding like py-24 or py-32 for sections.
layouts.alignment: Strict left-aligned text for sophisticated editorial feel. Do not center everything.

components.hero: Huge kinetic H1. Dark atmospheric background. Clear Call to Action.
components.category_section: Numbered chapters (e.g., '01 // MONEY TRANSFER'). High contrast separator lines.
components.domain_card: Includes: Domain Name (JetBrains Mono), Pitch Copy, Chain Badge (Polygon/Solana), and Buy Button (direct link to freename.io with ref=olive-ears-obey).
components.chain_badge: Small pill shape, monochrome or subtle tint. Polygon = purple tint, Solana = green/blue tint.
components.marquee: Massive outline text or small editorial ribbon.
components.footer: Presented by AIWEBTOOLS.AI. Massive brand text.

Cubes/blockchain network. Use sparingly with very low opacity (mix-blend-luminosity) in category sections.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against dark backgrounds. Avoid gray-on-gray.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-end static marketing page. DO NOT use Shadcn UI cards if they restrict layout. Build custom HTML/Tailwind for maximum creative control.
Install required libraries: `yarn add framer-motion lucide-react react-fast-marquee @studio-freight/lenis`
Font Loading: Update index.html or index.css to import Unbounded, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono.
Apply `bg-[#050505] text-white font-['Outfit']` to the body.
Use framer-motion for the masked text reveal in the hero section. (Wrap lines of text in overflow-hidden divs, translate y from 100% to 0%).
Cards: Implement the Glassmorphism 'Crystal' variant. Very low opacity background, sharp 1px border. Domain names in JetBrains Mono.
Include the noise overlay: Create a fixed div with a tiny SVG noise pattern background, mix-blend-overlay, opacity 15%.
Do not center-align the app container. Use optical alignment and maintain asymmetric visual tension.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts or uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
